name: Mom
source:
Pronouns: She/Her
Occupation: Botanist

Powers: Nature Regeneration
Dragon Spring: Naga

Your adoptive mother. She has cared for you for much of your life. It seems when you were younger, you had a natural affinity to care-taking and assisting her with tending to plants and helping dying plants recover. This may be where you both discovered your innate ability to heal. She has supported you with your journey as a healer. You should be grateful to call someone as loving as her your mother.

[spoiler]For reasons unknown to you, she has knowledge on matters related to Fae. While she brought them up in jest, she seems well-versed in herbs they don't like and rituals that aim to summon them. She has mentioned she learned about these from her grandmother and older family members. That being said, she does not seem to be a firm believer in the existence of Fae.[/spoiler]

[From in-game profile]
